Evidence ladder (claimed, artifact_backed, peer_attested, authority_verified)
nodes.rationale: rung is a denormalised read value written only by evidence module transition; a claim is never shown as verified (INV-T04); ai is not a valid source (INV-T08); attempt unverified cannot reach evidence (ADR-T13)

nodes.label: Consent model (append-only ledger, 14 scopes, consent_current)
nodes.rationale: Per-employer and per-artefact grants are rows of one ledger; scope vocabulary lives only in CONSENT_SCOPE_CATALOGUE (CSC, FF-12); evidence.share_recruiter retired and split by target

nodes.label: State machines referenced by CHECK constraints (14 SM-00 machines)
nodes.rationale: SM-00 is the single vocabulary source; enum-vs-SM lint (FF-11); SM-FILE provisional (REVW-20); SM-ERASURE folded into SM-DSR

nodes.label: account (DATA-E0101)
nodes.rationale: Carries consent_epoch and grants_version; status per SM-ACCOUNT; lockout is locked_until not a status

nodes.label: session (DATA-E0102)
nodes.rationale: Refresh-token family with rotation; reuse of a replaced token revokes family (BR-T050)

nodes.label: role_grant (DATA-E0205)
nodes.rationale: Platform roles moderator/support/admin/auditor; dormant grants auto-expire (60 d rule, USR-01 section 6)

nodes.label: evidence_event (DATA-E0505, append-only hash chain)
nodes.rationale: Soft references, no FK, so erasure can hard-delete item while history keeps bare id

nodes.label: reference_request (DATA-E0604)
nodes.rationale: Single-use token_hash only (INV-T05); 14 day expiry and max 2 reminders (BR-T004)

nodes.label: assessment (DATA-E0701)
nodes.rationale: ai_mode AI_PROHIBITED/RESTRICTED/ALLOWED; requires_runner for code/project (ADR-T13)

nodes.label: attempt (DATA-E0703)
nodes.rationale: ai_mode_snapshot copied at start so edits cannot weaken (INV-T06); evidence_id set only with valid verification_basis

nodes.label: integrity_flag (DATA-E0708, advisory human-reviewed)
nodes.rationale: INV-T20: reviewed_by required when cleared or confirmed

nodes.label: application (DATA-E1003)
nodes.rationale: Terminal rows immutable (INV-T11); draft state lives in application_draft

nodes.label: stage_transition (DATA-E1007, append-only hash chain)
nodes.rationale: actor_subject_ref NOT NULL enforces human actor (INV-T09)

nodes.label: search_candidate_doc (DATA-E1102, consent-gated derived)
nodes.rationale: consent_epoch mismatch invalidates the row

nodes.label: subscription / entitlement / stripe_event_inbox (billing)
nodes.rationale: provider_event_created_at guards out-of-order webhooks; entitlements derived server-side

nodes.label: ai_request / ai_suggestion / ai_budget / ai_spend
nodes.rationale: Prompt hash only, no raw prompt; allow_free_inference default false (INV-T07); AI suggestions kept separate from evidence (INV-T08)

nodes.label: support_access_grant (DATA-E2001)
nodes.rationale: Max 4 hour grant (BR-T041)

nodes.label: audit_anchor (DATA-E2004, KMS-signed Merkle batch)
nodes.rationale: Seals row_hash of audit_event, consent_record, evidence_event, stage_transition; no inline chain lock (REVW-06)

nodes.label: consent_record (DATA-E2201)
nodes.rationale: subject_ref opaque token replaces subject_account_id so ledger never needs rewriting; consent_grain_ck generated from CSC; consent_current view

nodes.label: subject_identity_map (DATA-E2208)
nodes.rationale: Only erasable link from history to a person (REVW-04); deleted as last erasure step; crypto-shred via wrapped_subject_key; INV-T38 post-erasure sweep

nodes.label: data_rights_request / erasure_request / erasure_step / erasure_ledger / legal_hold
nodes.rationale: Erasure due 30 days (BR-T060); erasure lifecycle is SM-DSR; erasure_ledger holds only opaque erased_subject_ref

nodes.label: outbox_event (DATA-E2401)
nodes.rationale: Written in same transaction as state change (INV-T12); published partitions dropped after 14 d

nodes.label: background_job (DATA-E2404)
nodes.rationale: lease_generation fencing token (ADR-T09); UNIQUE(kind, idempotency_key)

nodes.label: schema_migration (DATA-E2410)
nodes.rationale: Contiguous NNNNN versions (FF-10); kinds expand/backfill/contract/repair

nodes.label: webhook_endpoint / api_client / import_job (integrations)
nodes.rationale: SSRF-validated URLs at create and at send

nodes.label: OPEN-B13 competency.confidence numeric vs banded display
nodes.rationale: Relates to uncertainty display INV-T19
